data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3 million was experienced in 2014 (2013: GBP 6.4 million surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 2.0 million on direct business (2013: GBP 3.4 million surplus) and a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2013: GBP 3.0 million surplus).

prior_year_events.impact_description: favourable development of reserves across a number of classes of business, including engineering and power, following better than expected claims experience.
direct improvements primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books
reinsurance accepted deteriorations primarily arose from a deterioration on the casualty book

named_events.loss_description: loss of plant and equipment in a mining landslide
one large claim of note relating to the 2013 year of account in respect of a Canadian construction loss

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1.3 million in 2014, representing a 1.8% reduction of opening gross reserves. This was driven by a GBP 2.0 million surplus on direct business, primarily from the fire and other damage to property books, and favourable development on the 2012 year of account, particularly in engineering and power classes due to better than expected claims experience. This was partially offset by a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business, mainly due to deterioration on the casualty book.
